// Sink corpus for the exec-output taint engine (TestExecTaintSinks): where a
// spawn-derived value may end. Terminal writes — os.Stdout/os.Stderr, cobra's
// OutOrStdout/ErrOrStderr, fmt.Print* — are clean. An error, a file, the
// environment and the mutation recorder's text parameter are escapes. The
// clearance model lets an int or a bool through and nothing else: TrimSpace,
// Split, Fields and Sprintf keep the text, and so does a rune.
//
// Every transform-set package is called somewhere in this corpus or in
// sources.go.txt (TestTaintTransformSetIsExercised).
package sinks

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"regexp"
	"slices"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"unicode"

	"github.com/spf13/cobra"

	"github.com/Rivil/dross/internal/mutation"
)

// ---- terminal: the stream ends on the user's screen ----

func toStderr(c *exec.Cmd) {
	out, _ := c.Output()
	fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, string(out))
	os.Stderr.Write(out)
}

func toCobra(cmd *cobra.Command, c *exec.Cmd) {
	out, _ := c.Output()
	fmt.Fprint(cmd.ErrOrStderr(), string(out))
	cmd.OutOrStdout().Write(out)
}

func toStdout(c *exec.Cmd) {
	out, _ := c.Output()
	fmt.Printf("%s", out)
	fmt.Println(string(out))
}

// Printf mirrors internal/cmd/root.go's stdout wrapper: taint followed into it
// ends at fmt.Printf.
func Printf(format string, a ...any) { fmt.Printf(format, a...) }

func viaWrapper(c *exec.Cmd) {
	out, _ := c.Output()
	Printf("%s\n", out)
}

// ---- a writer that is not the terminal carries the stream onward ----

func intoBuilder(c *exec.Cmd) error {
	out, _ := c.Output()
	var b strings.Builder
	fmt.Fprint(&b, string(out))
	return errors.New(b.String()) // WANT taint
}

func intoBuffer(c *exec.Cmd) error {
	out, _ := c.Output()
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	fmt.Fprint(&buf, out)
	return errors.New(buf.String()) // WANT taint
}

// ---- unknown externals are escapes, never allowed by default ----

func toFile(c *exec.Cmd, p string) {
	out, _ := c.Output()
	_ = os.WriteFile(p, out, 0o600) // WANT taint
}

func toEnv(c *exec.Cmd) {
	out, _ := c.Output()
	_ = os.Setenv("DROSS_LAST", strings.TrimSpace(string(out))) // WANT taint
}

// ---- the recorder takes counts, never text ----

func recordedText(c *exec.Cmd) error {
	out, _ := c.Output()
	seen := mutation.Observed(len(out))
	return mutation.RecordToolFailure(string(out), 1, seen) // WANT taint
}

func recordedCount(c *exec.Cmd) error {
	out, _ := c.Output()
	return mutation.RecordToolFailure("git", 1, mutation.Observed(len(out)))
}

// ---- clearance: an int or a bool clears; text stays text ----

func parsed(c *exec.Cmd) error {
	out, _ := c.Output()
	n, err := strconv.Atoi(string(out))
	if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
		return errors.New("impossible, but errors.Is must not taint the sentinel")
	}
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("parse count: %w", err) // WANT taint
	}
	return fmt.Errorf("count %d", n)
}

func tested(c *exec.Cmd) error {
	out, _ := c.Output()
	s := string(out)
	if strings.Contains(s, "x") || strings.HasPrefix(s, "y") || s == "z" || len(s) > 3 {
		return errors.New("fixed prose")
	}
	return fmt.Errorf("%v %v %v %d %v", strings.Contains(s, "a"), strings.HasPrefix(s, "b"), s == "c", len(s),
		slices.Contains(strings.Split(s, "\n"), "d"))
}

func trimmed(c *exec.Cmd) error {
	out, _ := c.Output()
	return errors.New(strings.TrimSpace(string(out))) // WANT taint
}

func split(c *exec.Cmd) error {
	out, _ := c.Output()
	return errors.New(strings.Split(string(out), "\n")[0]) // WANT taint
}

func fielded(c *exec.Cmd) error {
	out, _ := c.Output()
	return errors.New(strings.Fields(string(out))[0]) // WANT taint
}

func formatted(c *exec.Cmd) error {
	out, _ := c.Output()
	return errors.New(fmt.Sprintf("got %s", out)) // WANT taint
}

func trimmedBytes(c *exec.Cmd) error {
	out, _ := c.Output()
	return errors.New(string(bytes.TrimSpace(out))) // WANT taint
}

// ---- a rune is an integer that carries text ----

func runeLoop(c *exec.Cmd) error {
	out, _ := c.Output()
	r := strings.NewReader(string(out))
	var b strings.Builder
	for {
		ch, _, err := r.ReadRune()
		if err != nil {
			break
		}
		b.WriteRune(ch)
	}
	return errors.New(b.String()) // WANT taint
}

func decodeLoop(c *exec.Cmd) error {
	out, _ := c.Output()
	var b strings.Builder
	for _, ch := range string(out) {
		b.WriteRune(unicode.ToUpper(ch))
	}
	return errors.New(b.String()) // WANT taint
}

// ---- the rest of the transform set keeps the text ----

var shaLine = regexp.MustCompile(`[0-9a-f]{40}`)

func matched(c *exec.Cmd) error {
	out, _ := c.Output()
	return errors.New(shaLine.FindString(string(out))) // WANT taint
}

func joined(c *exec.Cmd, root string) error {
	out, _ := c.Output()
	_, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, string(out))) // WANT taint
	return err
}

func sorted(c *exec.Cmd) error {
	out, _ := c.Output()
	lines := strings.Split(string(out), "\n")
	sort.Strings(lines)
	return errors.New(lines[0]) // WANT taint
}

type ghPR struct{ URL string }

func decoded(c *exec.Cmd) error {
	out, _ := c.Output()
	var pr ghPR
	if err := json.Unmarshal(out, &pr); err != nil {
		return errors.New("unparseable")
	}
	return errors.New(pr.URL) // WANT taint
}
